content.text: History of High Point | High Point, NC Loading Skip to Main Content HomeGovernmentDepartmentsMuseumOnline ResourcesHistory of High Point History of High Point The town of High Point was chartered on May 26, 1859. It was located at the crossroads of the North Carolina Railroad and the Fayetteville and Western Plank Road (now Main Street). This intersection was the highest point on the railroad which stretched between Goldsboro and Charlotte, thus inspiring the name of the new town. View City Directories and Yearbooks on DigitalNC If you have any specific genealogical or local High Point History questions contact the Heritage Research Center.
